title: Nick Sirianni: Eagles will stick with Tanner McKee, Sean Mannion despite offensive woes

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Nick Sirianni: Eagles will stick with Tanner McKee, Sean Mannion despite offensive woes
sources.description: The Eagles have lost six in a row and rank 30th in the NFL in points per game, but Nick Sirianni said Monday that he isn't making a change at offensive coordinator or quarterback.
